### Week 2 Assignment

-  Review Literature Review Guidance
    - has this already been done?
        - are proper methods?

    - how to find papers?
        - google scholar
            - use keywords (e.g. species distribution, ecosystem, modeling, etc). 

-  Summarize the papers 
    - read 5, 6, 10 
        - okay to use old papers, but look for new as well. 

    - Summarize (at least 1 paper):
        - Background
        - Methods used
        - Significance 
        - Connection to other work
        - Relevance to capstone
